'Asli-Ubtan-for-Asli-Glow'-
Nat Habit, one of India’s fastest-growing Fresh Ayurveda personal care brands, has launched its latest campaign, “Asli Ubtan for Asli Glow,” for its Brightening & DeTan Ubtan Tikta Face Wash.
The campaign brings attention to the fact that repeated cleansing can strip the skin of its natural oils, potentially leaving it feeling dry and tight. In contrast, Nat Habit’s Ubtan Face Wash is designed to make cleansing an active part of the skin-renewal process.
As her face-washing becomes increasingly exaggerated, the film challenges the familiar belief that more cleansing means more glow, while highlighting that effective cleansing need not come at the cost of the skin’s natural oils and moisture.
At the heart of the formulation is Patented LentiClear™️ Technology -Nat Habit’s technology that harnesses the power of lentils and dals with natural cleansing surfactants.
What makes the formulation distinct is how it brings the traditional Ubtan ritual into a technology-led daily cleanser. Instead of simply adding familiar Ubtan ingredients to a conventional face wash, Nat Habit combines real dals, besan, turmeric and rakt chandan with its LentiClear™️ technology to create a modern cleansing system.
This brings together the traditional benefits associated with Ubtan with a contemporary formulation designed for cleansing, gentle exfoliation, brightening and de-tanning—all in one daily-use face wash. In doing so, Nat Habit reimagines Ubtan not as an occasional beauty ritual, but as a thoughtful, everyday approach to cleansing and skin renewal.
Commenting on the campaign, Swagatika Das, Co-Founder – Nat Habit said, “At Nat Habit, we believe innovation begins by questioning habits that consumers have accepted as routine. Frequent face washing may create an immediate sense of freshness, but it can also leave the skin stripped of its natural oils.
Our campaign brings this everyday habit to life in a simple and relatable way, encouraging consumers to question whether more washing really means more glow.
Nat Habit’s Tikta category comprises fresh, 100% natural Ayurvedic face washes that bring together bitter herbs including neem, karela, amla and ubtan pastes. The category has seen strong consumer adoption, with Ubtan Face Wash emerging as the fastest-growing product in the category.
The Ubtan Face Wash has also been recognized with the ASSOCHAM Best Natural/Organic Product of the Year 2024 , further adding to its product credentials.

It's the outcome of an easy, everyday ritual, initiated early enough to allow your skin to do its job.
However, ubtan face wash is among the best solutions used by many brides-to-be to achieve glorious skin before the wedding. So, let’s understand the rituals in steps to get the maximum effect of haldi ubtan face wash to get a natural bridal glow.
Plan Your 60-Day Natural Bridal Skin Routine at Home
Whether you are looking to achieve a regular bridal glow or are a bride-to-be looking for natural pre-bridal skincare at home, you just need to follow a 2-month routine to get the result.
In the next sixty days, you can clean the dull and dead skin, allow cells to self-heal, and get your inner glow back with lasting results, following the routine below.
How Should Your Morning Routine Be?

Conclusion
The best thing that begins a bridal glow at home is that one choice: starting early, choosing natural, and being consistent. Ubtan Face Wash provides your skin with the right ingredients to brighten, clear, and nourish it, making you ready for your everyday look.
No dramatic treatments and no complicated regimens.
When you stop fighting skin with chemicals and begin supporting it with nature, skin will work the way it works best. Thus, take the challenge of a bridal skincare ritual for 60 days and let your skin shine.

Why Ubtan Is the Best Natural Face Wash
June 1, 2026
Why Ubtan Is the Best Natural Face Wash
For centuries, Ubtan has been a trusted skincare remedy in Indian households. Made from natural ingredients such as gram flour (besan), turmeric, sandalwood, rose petals, and herbs, Ubtan gently cleanses the skin without exposing it to harsh chemicals.
Unlike many conventional face washes that may strip the skin of its natural oils, Ubtan helps maintain the skin's natural moisture balance while leaving it fresh and radiant.
Benefits of Using Ubtan as a Natural Face Wash
1. Deep Cleanses Without Harsh Chemicals
Ubtan effectively removes dirt, excess oil, and impurities from the skin while being gentle enough for regular use. Its natural ingredients cleanse without causing dryness or irritation.
2. Brightens the Complexion
Ingredients like turmeric and sandalwood are known for their skin-brightening properties. Regular use of Ubtan can help reveal a fresher and more radiant-looking complexion.
3. Helps Remove Tan
Ubtan is widely used as a natural de-tan treatment. It helps exfoliate dead skin cells and may reduce the appearance of sun tan, making the skin look more even-toned.
4. Gentle Exfoliation
The natural grains and herbal powders in Ubtan provide mild exfoliation, helping remove dead skin cells and promoting smoother, softer skin.
5. Suitable for Most Skin Types
Since Ubtan is made from natural ingredients, it is generally suitable for oily, combination, and normal skin types. Different herbs can also be added to customize it for specific skin concerns.
6. Supports Healthy-Looking Skin
Rich in antioxidants and botanical ingredients, Ubtan helps nourish the skin and supports a healthy, natural glow.
How to Use Ubtan
1. Take a small amount of Ubtan powder.
2. Mix it with rose water, milk, curd, or plain water.
3. Apply gently to the face and neck.
4. Massage in circular motions for 1–2 minutes.
5. Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry.
Final Thoughts
Ubtan remains one of the best natural alternatives to chemical-based face washes. Its ability to cleanse, exfoliate, brighten, and nourish the skin makes it a timeless skincare solution. If you're looking for a gentle and natural way to care for your skin, Ubtan can be an excellent addition to your daily skincare routine.
